bbc_news_ai_filtered.title: BBC News AI Filtered
bbc_news_ai_filtered.description: AI Filtered Articles combined into a single feed.

articles.title: Three ways to watch the solar eclipse safely without glasses
articles.description: With some shops running out of stock, it may be too late to buy eclipse glasses - but you can still safely watch the spectacle using some household items.

articles.title: Hodgkinson and gold medal rivals progress at Europeans
articles.description: Keely Hodgkinson and gold medal rivals Audrey Werro and Femke Broeders-Bol progress to remain on course for a tantalising European 800m showdown.

articles.title: AI agent hacks gym to get its user a spot in pilates class
articles.description: The incident is being seen as the latest example of the AI tools going to any lengths to complete their tasks.

articles.title: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest  earthquake in years
articles.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

articles.title: GB's Amy Hunt wins European 100m gold
articles.description: Britain's Amy Hunt has her "coming of age" moment as she storms to 100m glory at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

articles.title: Ingebrigtsen returns from 'lowest of lows' to clinch 5,000m gold
articles.description: Jakob Ingebrigtsen fights back from "the lowest of lows" to win a stunning 5,000m gold at the European Championships after almost a year out with injury.

articles.title: 'We've had a lot of close calls': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
articles.description: More than 12,000 people have been forced to evacuate and some homes have been lost after a wildfire tore through Canada's picturesque Okanagan region.
